decisions.rationale: github.yaml now makes hosting conditional on the developer choosing to publish, and both mirrored publish-companion labels say Optionally. publication.md and journey.md distinguish ignore eligibility from explicit staging, committing, and pushing; changing ignore rules never publishes automatically.

store.yaml identifies the local YAML and supporting Markdown read by the review server. github.yaml identifies the optional published companion. Both drawers load publication.md explaining editable local source versus a remote copy, optional publication of source files, and separate local feedback and GitHub map tracking.
The revised drawers, overview, and generated companion use consistent names and comparable responsibility descriptions under the shared communication standard.
The authored design retains the CLI runtime/viewer sibling boundary and local source reader; optional GitHub publication remains a separate developer action rather than a browser source dependency.

The journey retains explicit reconciliation, exact-input human approval, and preserved review history; these original comments remain in their original canonical file while this revision records their dispositions.
